newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama Canal transit to return to normal next week.
newsitem.headline: Panama Canal transit to return to normal next week.

text.p: Transit through the Panama Canal is expected to return to normal next week following the removal of the wreckage of a sunken tugboat that was partly blocking it, Panama Canal Commission (PCC) officials said Monday.

The queue of vessels awaiting transit will hover around 90 before returning to normal levels in a week's time, PCC spokesman Franklin Castrellon said. "We are doing everything possible to bring the levels back down to normal," he said.

The tugboat, which had sunk on April 21 while doing dredging work, was removed at 1402 local (1702 GMT) Sunday, "earlier than expected," he said, adding "traffic for both directions of Miraflores Locks began at 6:51 AM (1151 GMT) today."
